subject: Next week: writing tests and handling errors in your R functions. And, more paper discussions coming!

messages.subject: Next week: writing tests and handling errors in your R functions. And, more paper discussions coming!
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies,
In a change of schedule, next week's meeting (10-12 Wednesday Oct. 26 in the DataLab classroom or via Zoom) will begin with a mini-workshop from ME, Wesley Brooks, talking about writing unit tests and handling errors in R functions.

During our paper discussion a week ago, everyone agreed that they are more of an "R User" than an "R Developer", and most of us had never written unit tests or error handlers. Well, I am here to help get us started on closing that gap. I'll go over the why and how of testing and error handling, and teach you all the basics of the testthat and rlang packages.

In a few weeks (Nov. 9) we will discuss the follow-up commentaries from the paper we discussed last week. There are four commentaries, each between 1-2 pages. So let's please read them all in the next few weeks and come on November 9 prepared to discuss how science interacts with R programming.

See you next week!
-Wes
